thread:
henry: noticed a cost blip and higher p99 for interactive in us-east1 at 03:45 UTC. spike aligns with a cluster-wide preemptible drain.

priya: saw it. Preempt count ~32% of pool during window. interactive queue p99 went from 120ms -> 950ms.

eva: any pattern on instance families? noisy neighbor logs?

infra-monitor: automatic alert: preemptible_eviction_rate > 25% in us-east1 for 6m. attached sample logs.

ops-bot: log snippet:
```
2026-04-02T03:46:11Z node=us-east1-c-14 event=PREEMPT reason=GCE_PREEMPT signal=TERMINATE
2026-04-02T03:46:19Z node=us-east1-c-14 event=DEVICE_ERROR reason=HOST_GC signal=KILL
```

luis: HOST_GC entries mean host-level pauses, often correlated with certain machine families. We could add a "stability score" per family and prefer high-score families for interactive.

henry: agree. Proposal: keep interactive on stable families (A100x and A800 series), move nonlatency-critical workloads to mixed spot pool with more aggressive retry/backoff.

priya: also add per-job checkpointing for batch so we don't waste egress/compute on full restarts. simplest: checkpoint to GCS every N minutes; allow resume token in job API.

eva: we need anti-flap gating. don't flip routing on a single 1m blip. Suggest: require 3/5 windows breaching or 10m sustained.

luis: draft allocator rule sketch:
```
route:
  name: interactive-stability-fallback
  triggers:
    - metric: interactive_p99
      threshold: 500ms
      window: 5m
    - metric: preempt_rate_region
      threshold: 20%
      window: 5m
  gating: min_triggers: 2, stability: 10m
  action: route_to: dedicated-small, duration: 15m
```

henry: also consider partial routing: scale weight to 30% dedicated at first, then increase if latency doesn't recover.

priya: cost note: dedicated-small is ~2.4x unit cost of spot. route % must be conservative. Add a monthly alert for cumulative cost from automatic fallbacks.

infra-monitor: adding telemetry event for every automated fallback. will emit: fallback_id, region, cause, pre/post cost-estimate.

eva: ops playbook updates: add steps to query family stability index, run quick simulation with current queued mix, and manual override if auto-routing misbehaves.

luis: I'll implement family scoring + allocator weight override this sprint. priya will own checkpoint resume API. henry will own rollout plan and runbook.

henry: timeline?

luis: scoring prototype in 3 days, allocator hook in 7, feature flag gated rollout next week.

priya: checkpoint API in 5 days, dashboard for fallback cost in 4 days.

henry: thanks. post PR links here when ready. will prepare a short customer note template in case we need to call out dedicated routing.

participants: henry, priya, eva, luis, infra-monitor, ops-bot
